runSummary.note: Real 16 Sep 10:53 sweep. Ten independent source families were actually queried: Profesia, direct company/public career pages, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Kariera, Pretlak, Upwork, WordPress Jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. No new offer met both fit and evidence threshold for safe LIVE promotion. Kaufland Bratislava IT Service & Support was reverified as active via a fresh public listing. Allegro/Mall.sk Junior partner support is 100% home office but requires fluent Hungarian and Slovak, so it is not a fit. DTSE Bratislava end-user IT support requires English B2. Fresh Upwork WordPress/WooCommerce technical jobs were remote but demanded PHP/server/database/performance expertise or native English/US-hours. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable posts.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Hard-skill evidence matrix
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Track each specialist requirement as proven / adjacent / unproven and automatically suppress roles where multiple mandatory hard skills are unproven, while preserving adjacent troubleshooting roles.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Language combination gate
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Parse multi-language requirements as AND/OR combinations so roles requiring several fluent languages are rejected immediately, while optional translation-assisted languages do not create false penalties.

policy.contentAgeVsVerificationAge: updatedAt/contentUpdatedAt describes data-content age; sourceVerificationAt describes when sources were actually checked; each job verifiedAt describes that job's evidence age.
policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.discovery: List/search resurfacing can create a candidate but never verifiedAt or LIVE promotion by itself.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data was attempted.
